name: costmarket
title: Cost Market
description: Monthly prediction market on the average AI cost per user of the build console — pay a monthly minimum, stake it on where the month lands, parimutuel payout settled against build's published cost oracle

oracle.docs: The settlement figure: total metered task spend divided by distinct users, per UTC calendar month. Only read when the endpoint reports final=true.

market.docs: close_fraction 0.5 = betting shuts at the midpoint of the month. bucket_edges_usd are the boundaries; N edges make N+1 buckets, the last one open-ended.

chain.docs: Set rpc + token + market.treasury to verify subscription payments on-chain. Left empty, subscriptions are recorded on trust (local play) and flagged unverified.

/status.docs: Current epoch, phase, pool, membership counts

/oracle.docs: Passthrough to build's /costs/epoch/{month} — the number this market settles on

/epoch/{month}.docs: One epoch: buckets, stake per bucket, implied odds, phase

/book/{month}.docs: Every bet in an epoch (public book)

/subscribe.docs: Pay the monthly minimum: {address, amount_usd?, tx_hash?, month?}. The amount paid becomes that month's stake budget.

/bet.docs: Stake into a bucket: {address, bucket, amount_usd?, month?}. Requires an active membership; spends from the month's stake budget; refused once betting closes.

/treasury.docs: Subscriptions collected, fees earned, balances owed

/withdraw.docs: Claim settled winnings: {address, amount_usd?}. Records a claim; the owner settles it.

/settle.docs: Resolve a finished epoch against the oracle and pay the winning bucket: {month, key}. Refuses an unfinished month or a non-final oracle reading.

/confirm.docs: Confirm a subscription the chain check couldn't verify: {address, month, key}

/buckets.docs: Redraw an epoch's buckets before it has any bets: {month, edges, key}
